title: Lampkeep of the Green Spire
subtitle: A single night on the mist road

intro.body: You are the newly appointed Lampkeep of the Green Spire — a freehouse on a highland mist road. Travelers arrive unfinished. Oil is limited. Rooms remember kindness. Usher every guest to a leave-path before dawn.
intro.tip: You will learn by lighting one room, staging a prop, and inviting your first traveler.

tutorial.bell1: Light the Map Room (2 oil), then Stage it with the Kettle or Map Table.
tutorial.afterLit: Stage places props. Mira wants a kettle or a map.
tutorial.afterStaged: Invite Mira into the Map Room.
tutorial.bell2: Cadence and Bram both want the Hearth. Light it, then Mediate.
tutorial.bell4: The Hollow Guest cannot rest here. Refuse them, or soft-close the Cellar — lingering raises Strain.
tutorial.dawn: Ring Dawn when you are ready.

roomsHint: Tap a room to light, stage, or invite

actionHints.lightCellDetail: Cost 2 oil — Opens a leave-path later
actionHints.mediateDetail: Free — Choose who keeps the fire
actionHints.closeCellarDetail: No oil — Ends one subplot early

goal: Usher every guest to a completed rest chapter before dawn. Perfect Night: oil remaining and no corridor sealed harshly.
goalStats: Guests settled {settled}/{total} · Leave-paths open {ready}/{total} · Strain {strain} · Assist: oil costs shown
freeInvite: Invite is free — this room was just staged.

mira.name: Mira of the Switchbacks
mira.arrival: A rain-dark cloak at the door. Mira of the Switchbacks asks for a quiet map and a kettle that remembers the ridge.
mira.need: Wants Map Room + Kettle, Map Table, or Trail Stamp.
mira.quirk: She hums if the lamp is steady.
mira.interaction: Keep the lamp level and I'll keep my boots off the map. The ridge path is kinder when someone remembers the kettle.
mira.invite: Mira settles by the map, boots carefully aside.
mira.rest: Mira's leave-path opens toward the ridge.
mira.hook: One Bell of rest in the Map Room or Quiet Cell with a kettle, map, or trail prop.

cadence.name: Cadence Coilwright
cadence.arrival: Cadence Coilwright stamps mist from brass-buckled boots and eyes the Hearth. "Fire for the solder," he says.
cadence.quirk: Leaves a tiny geared clasp if he rests well.
cadence.interaction: Fire for the solder, quiet for the springs — both, if the Spire allows.
cadence.share: Cadence nods at the shared hearth and clears a corner for gears.
cadence.hook: One Bell of rest in Hearth Hall with the Workbench Kit. Can share the hearth.

bram.name: Bram Whisperwick
bram.arrival: Bram Whisperwick follows the smell of fire. "A story needs a fire or a cloak — never neither."
bram.need: Prefers Hearth; accepts Quiet Cell with Spare Cloak.
bram.quirk: Stubborn about audience until offered a cloak and quiet.
bram.interaction: Give me fire, or give me a cloak and a smaller room. I will not stand in the foyer telling jokes to the door.
bram.alternate: Bram wraps the cloak and takes the Quiet Cell, already rewriting the opening line.
bram.hook: Hearth Hall, or Quiet Cell with the Spare Cloak. One Bell of rest.

hollow.name: The Hollow Guest
hollow.arrival: A fifth knock that isn't a knock — the Hollow Guest stands where the lamplight thins. They cannot rest here. Kindness may still choose how they leave.
hollow.need: Cannot complete Rest. Refuse, or soft-close the Cellar Archive.
hollow.interaction: I was never meant to stay past the third Bell. Do not light a room for me.
hollow.refuse: You decline the Hollow Guest. They fade toward the mist without blame.
hollow.softClose: You soft-close the Cellar. The Hollow Guest's subplot ends. Strain settles heavier by one.
hollow.harshClose: You seal the Cellar harshly. The Spire remembers the slam. Strain +2.
hollow.hook: Cannot rest. Refuse, or soft-close the Cellar. Lingering raises Strain each Bell.

mediate.title: Mediate the Hearth
mediate.body: Cadence and Bram both want Hearth Hall.
mediate.cadenceDetail: Bram will wait for another room.
mediate.bramDetail: Cadence only accepts the hearth; waiting may raise Strain.
mediate.shareDetail: Requires Workbench Kit staged (spent now if needed). Both may rest together.

roof_drip.title: Roof Drip
roof_drip.body: Rain finds a seam in the Map Room roof.
roof_drip.effect: If Map Room is occupied, Strain +1 unless you spend 1 oil to steady the lamp (optional choice).
roof_drip.drip: Let it drip (+1 Strain if occupied)

oil_gift.title: A Kind Flask
oil_gift.body: A previous keeper left a flask behind the foyer ledger.
oil_gift.effect: Gain 2 oil (max does not apply; oil may exceed start).

double_knock.title: Double Knock
double_knock.body: Two knocks echo — only wind. You steal a breath and an extra action.

steady_wick.title: Steady Wick
steady_wick.body: The wicks catch evenly for a moment.
steady_wick.effect: Next Light costs 1 oil instead of 2 (one-shot flag).

epilogue.kicker: Dawn Epilogue — Night of Soft Rain
epilogue.miraComplete: She took the ridge path with a full kettle song. The mist kept its distance.
epilogue.miraUnfinished: She left before the kettle sang. The ridge will wait.
epilogue.cadenceComplete: He left a tiny geared clasp on the hearth mantel — a thank-you that clicks once at noon.
epilogue.cadenceUnfinished: His tools stayed packed. The solder cooled unused.
epilogue.bramComplete: He borrowed the spare cloak and promised a better story next mist-season.
epilogue.bramUnfinished: He left before the cloak warmed. The story will wait for a kinder Bell.
epilogue.hollowKind: The Hollow Guest did not stay. The Spire stayed kind.
epilogue.hollowLingered: Dawn found the Hollow Guest still in the thinning dark. Strain clung like wet wool.
epilogue.perfectBody: All leave-paths open. Oil remained. No harsh seals. The mist bowed.
epilogue.warmBody: Every traveler who could rest, did. Dawn was honest and kind.
epilogue.strainedBody: Dawn came with heavier shoulders. Some songs unfinished — but the door still faced the road.
epilogue.failedBody: Dawn came anyway. The Spire kept who it could. You set the night down with careful hands.
epilogue.lanternBody: Always available — never locked behind winning. A small amber lantern beside the guestbook opens About. The night can end without visiting it.

about.title: About
about.p1: This is Spencer Sweeney's personal website.
about.p2: You are playing Lampkeep of the Green Spire — a short hospitality game set in an original fantasy freehouse.
about.p3: Spencer also keeps an older solar-system / space page as part of this site.

settings.title: Settings
settings.abandonConfirm: Abandon this night? Progress will be lost.
settings.nextNight: Relaxed Oil, Host hints, and Prop refresh apply on the next New Night.

errors.room_dark: That room is dark. Light it first.
errors.guest_refuses_room: That guest will not rest in this room.
errors.dawn_not_ready: Ring Dawn is not ready — a traveler still needs a leave-path.
errors.workbench_missing: Workbench Kit is not available to share.
errors.foyer: The Foyer stays as it is.
errors.not_hollow: Only the Hollow Guest can be refused.

rules.body: Each Bell: up to 2 actions. Light costs 2 oil. Stage props. Invite guests. Mediate contests. The Hollow Guest cannot rest — refuse or soft-close. Ring Dawn when leave-paths are ready. Undo with U.
rules.keys: Keys: 1 Light, 2 Stage, 3 Invite, 4 Mediate, 5 Close Soft, E End Bell, D Ring Dawn, U Undo, Esc close, ? Rules, A About.

notices.hint: No one moved closer to a leave-path last Bell. Light a room a guest will accept, or stage a prop they asked for.
notices.share: The hearth is shared. Both may rest.
notices.awardCadence: The hearth is Cadence's. Bram will need another room.
notices.awardBram: The hearth is Bram's. Cadence will keep waiting unless the hearth opens again.

confirm.title: Ring Dawn
confirm.body: End the night and read the dawn leave-lines?
